description: Pull a US-listed company's official SEC profile, latest filings and headline financials. By ticker, CIK or name: CIK, SIC, state, addresses, former names, latest filings with a form filter and direct document links, plus XBRL figures (revenue, net income, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, shares) with period and filing reference, straight from SEC EDGAR. Use when you need primary-source data on an SEC registrant. $0.002 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.
